name: quests.refusalPark
why_off: A guard that refused the same quest chunk three times counted as StepFailed and parked as gave_up (a vague 'the step kept failing'), and a stall of refusals climbed the failsafe up to the game restart, which fixes nothing. The knob parks identical coded refusals as refused_repeatedly with the code and text and skips rung 4 for refusal-only stalls; built and tested offline only (fake clock, two classes).
enable_criteria: Fake-clock tests green (go test ./internal/questboard ./internal/bot), then a 2 h flip window on one sandbox whose quests.boardSM is 1: a repeated coded refusal shows reason refused_repeatedly with its code and text in /api/quests and the Return screen's Quests paused section, no game restart for a refusal-only stall; no hard breach (docs/process/dark-launch.md).
